name: fluttergo-ai
description: Build, preview and ship Flutter apps for iOS and Android from chat with your FlutterGo.AI account.

interface.longDescription:
FlutterGo.AI connects ChatGPT to a cloud Flutter studio. Sign in with your FlutterGo.AI account, then build a mobile app step by step in the chat.

What you can do:
- Create a project and follow guided build stages: plan, design kit, screens and a quality check.
- Write and edit the project's Dart, YAML and docs, and add images and icons.
- Compile a live web preview of the app and see compile errors.
- Build an Android APK in the cloud and get a download link.
- Link a GitHub repository and push or pull the code.
- Import screens from a Figma file.
- Check app store readiness and deploy to TestFlight or Google Play. Store credentials are entered on the FlutterGo.AI website, never in the chat, and every deployment needs your confirmation.
- Download the full project source code.
capabilities: Create Flutter projects and write their code
Build Android APKs in the cloud
Sync with GitHub and import from Figma
defaultPrompt: Build me a recipe app in Flutter with FlutterGo.
Show my FlutterGo projects and preview the latest one.
Build an Android APK of my FlutterGo project.
